purpose: Cheap falsification of two new, separately named event-level mechanisms using only locally supplied point-in-time records. This catalog neither changes frozen strategy-zoo-v2 nor reopens W1/W2 session watches or D4 volatility-state transfer.

data_boundary.execution: decision at an observed event; enter at the first strictly later quote after declared latency; exit at the first quote at or after the declared horizon; no same-event/same-close fill

candidates.hypothesis: When one-second signed aggressive trade size is strongly one-sided but the contemporaneously observable midpoint has not travelled by even one quarter of the earlier quoted spread in that direction, passive liquidity has absorbed the impulse; the next short-horizon move should be opposite the aggressor side.
candidates.economic_rationale: This tests flow-price impact divergence, not a static CVD, session, BTC-alignment, or volatility-state filter. It is a reversal mechanism that requires a measurable failure of aggressive flow to move the quote.

controls.null_or_sign_control: same timestamps with signal sign reversed; analyse only as a named diagnostic in a later independently specified run
controls.redundancy_guard: Must report overlap with DEVQ-SPREAD-RESOLUTION-001; signal Jaccard above catalog limit blocks progression absent separately specified incremental evidence.
expected_failure_regimes: one-sided news jumps where quotes lag
quoted depth that withdraws instead of absorbs

candidates.hypothesis: After a brief BBO spread shock, a return of the spread to near baseline while the midpoint remains displaced by at least three quarters of the baseline spread reflects a resolved liquidity shock; the next short-horizon move should continue in the resolved midpoint direction.
candidates.economic_rationale: This tests quote-resilience and price discovery from BBO dynamics alone. It deliberately uses neither trade-flow imbalance nor UTC-session, BTC, funding, or volatility-transfer filters, so it is not a retune of W1/W2 or D4.
